classification.difficultyReason: Convert ratio parts to sector angles and construct a labelled pie chart.

content.prompt: A sum of money is divided in the ratio $1:3:5$. Draw a pie chart to illustrate the division. Indicate the angles of the sectors carefully.

answer.short: The sectors for $1:3:5$ have angles $40^\circ$, $120^\circ$ and $200^\circ$, respectively.
answer.worked:
There are $1+3+5=9$ equal ratio parts.

$$\begin{align*}\text{Angle for 1 part}&=\frac{1}{9}\times360^\circ=40^\circ\\\text{Angle for 3 parts}&=\frac{3}{9}\times360^\circ=120^\circ\\\text{Angle for 5 parts}&=\frac{5}{9}\times360^\circ=200^\circ\end{align*}$$

Draw and label the three sectors using these angles.

spec.description: Complete unequal-sector pie chart labelled by ratio part and angle.
spec.mathematics: Sector angles 40, 120 and 200 degrees in ratio 1:3:5.
